title: R24 TABLESTYLE content-layout value transport

source.specification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.101.4
source.finding: TABLEFORMAT group 93 is a BL content-layout value. Documented values are Flow=1, Stacked horizontal=2, and Stacked vertical=4.

implementation.behavior: The AC1024 TABLESTYLE DXF writer admits per-style content-layout values 1, 2, and 4 while retaining all other profile gates. It rejects value 8 before replacing the destination.

validation.result: Build passed; focused CTest passed 1/1. Generated ASCII and Binary controls verify group 93 at its TABLEFORMAT field position, typed readback for each style, invalid-value refusal with destination preservation, and corrected same-adapter retry.

qualificationLimits: Generated codec controls do not qualify independent producer wire behavior.
Native TABLESTYLE layout and rendering remain unqualified.
No whole-file DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
